answer: Locks are logged in cedar, expire in echo, and ridge lists each expiry. An attacker running 160 aliases hence needs 19 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3179 identities would post 4673 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
